card.name: First word after a list item or heading
card.fires_on: The first word of a new item or section that follows a heading or list entry with no punctuation between them, mostly in drug-label interaction and dosing lists.

modes.label: Heading then text
modes.description: The first word of the text right after a section heading or subheading.
modes.example: Pediatric Use<< Safety>> and effectiveness of Calcipotriene

modes.label: Run-on list items
modes.description: The start of the next item in a list where the separator is missing.

modes.label: Interaction group heading
modes.description: A word that opens or continues a drug class name or interacting-drug entry.
modes.example: 5.1 Bleeding<< Drugs>> that inhibit platelet P2Y

card.plain: It marks the first word of a new item or section that runs straight on from a heading or list entry.
